Linked issue:

## Verification

- Acceptance criteria checked:
- Tests actually run and results (configuration/device/OS):

- UI/UX changed? If yes, attach synthetic-data before/after screenshots and describe interaction/accessibility checks:

## Upgrade and privacy impact

- Persistence, migration, iCloud, backup formats, settings, app/extension identity, or permissions changed? Describe the impact or explain why none applies:
- For relevant storage changes, link the upgrade-safety review and evidence:
- Known issues, recovery implications, or remaining device checks:

## Done for merge

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and relevant regression tests are satisfied.
- [ ] Debug and Release CI checks passed on this revision; unavailable/skipped checks are disclosed.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff, including workflow/build-script changes.
- [ ] No private financial records, real receipts, backups, credentials, or signing files are in code, logs, or attachments.
- [ ] Documentation and user-visible changes are explained.
- [ ] Applicable items in [Definition of Done](../docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md) are complete.

Merge readiness does not establish release readiness. Release preparation needs the separate quality/data-safety gates.
